findings.detail: Adaptive section states not foolproof and asks users to test on their own data. Preserve this qualification alongside other stronger promises.

Document differentiates algo4 from mutually compatible1..3; whole-file equality or cache key must not ignore codec parameters. Backend selected dynamically as Cython or pure Python; metadata alone does not identify measured implementation.

Duplication discussion concerns archival redundancy/repair and mentions deduplication as a separate preprocessing operation. This candidate offers robustness lessons rather than a replacement discovery engine.

Large storage-media/cost/firmware/cryptography comparison sections are historical upstream prose, not verified recommendations or requirements. No external commands executed and no hardware/network state changed.

Later recovery example uses filescraping_recover while implementation flag is filescraping_recovery. Storage recommendation sections contain different vintage preferred-media advice; documentation is not a current capability matrix.
Build/coverage badges are remote status references, not pinned run evidence. Entire text review does not imply image review, dependency audit, or successful packaged integration.
